plugins.name: photocraft
plugins.description: Edit images headlessly with PhotoCraft, an open-source Photoshop-style editor: crop, adjustments, filters, layers, masks, compositing and PSD export.

plugins.name: filmcraft
plugins.description: Edit video headlessly with FilmCraft, an open-source Premiere-style editor: import media, build sequences, cut, apply effects, render frames and export.

plugins.name: lightcraft
plugins.description: Develop and export photos headlessly with LightCraft, an open-source Lightroom-style raw developer: exposure, colour, presets, auto settings, HDR/panorama merge and batch export.
